name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 3px #005fcc ring with 1px white inner ring. It’s tighter, so it won’t blur into background colors or bleed under high-contrast modes, keeping focus visible on every interactive element. The trade-off is slightly less visual prominence than the 4px version, but that’s acceptable because the 3px ring still meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast requirements and avoids the risk of obscuring adjacent content.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring risks disappearing entirely on backgrounds where #005fcc blends—especially on patterned or textured surfaces. A 4px outer ring with a 2px white inner ring keeps focus visible without blurring, but only if contrast ratios meet WCAG 2.1 AA (4.5:1 for normal text). Test both rings at 100% and 200% zoom on low-contrast backgrounds to settle it.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 4px #005fcc outer ring with a 2px white inner ring. This keeps focus visible on patterned or textured backgrounds where the 3px version risks disappearing, meeting WCAG 2.1 AA contrast (4.5:1) without relying on high-contrast modes. The trade-off is slightly more visual weight, but that’s necessary for reliability across surfaces.

name: Reader
text: The 4px ring still risks blending on patterned backgrounds if #005fcc’s contrast drops below 4.5:1. A 2px solid white outer ring with a 4px #005fcc inner ring guarantees visibility but adds visual noise. Test both rings on a high-contrast checkerboard at 100% zoom—if the 4px #005fcc ring fails, the white outer ring wins.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Adopt the 4px #005fcc outer ring with 2px white inner ring as the default focus indicator. The result must deliver a tested, WCAG 2.1 AA-compliant focus ring that remains visible on all backgrounds, including patterned/textured surfaces, with no blending risks. Owner: accessibility-w1.
